fields.climate: subtropical in lowlands, temperate in mountains
fields.terrain: mostly mountains in interior, narrow coastal plains
fields.hazards: frequent, but generally mild, earthquakes; extremely susceptible to damaging hurricanes and floods along the Caribbean coast
fields.resources: timber, gold, silver, copper, lead, zinc, iron ore, antimony, coal, fish, hydropower
fields.farm: sugarcane, oil palm fruit, maize, milk, bananas, coffee, cantaloupes/melons, oranges, chicken, beans
fields.exports: garments, coffee, insulated wire, palm oil, shellfish
fields.industries: sugar processing, coffee, woven and knit apparel, wood products, cigars
fields.suffrage: 18 years of age; universal and compulsory
fields.military: 18-22 years of age for voluntary military service for men and women; 24–36 month service obligation; no conscription
